subject: Vendor payment synchronization & PO routing for Valence AI
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Valence AI - AP <ap@valence.ai>; Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@valence.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: payment cadence & PO routing (Valence AI)
Attachments: redwood_po_template.xlsx, valence_onboarding_form.docx

Hi Jordan / Valence AP team,

Thanks for starting the onboarding paperwork. Two quick items I want to align on before we finalize your vendor record and PO routing:

- Payment cadence: our standard onboarding window is Net 45 to ensure predictable cashflow for the platform, but we routinely make exceptions for strategic partners. Can you confirm whether Valence prefers Net 30, Net 45 or Net 60?
- Early-pay program: we have an optional early-pay enrollment (managed by Finance) that provides an incentive for faster payment in exchange for a small fee. If youre interested, please indicate the discount cadence youd expect (example: 1%/10, 0.5%/7).
- PO routing / invoice header: to avoid delays, please ensure your invoices include the Redwood PO number on the first line of the invoice and send PDFs to ap-invoices@redwood.com. If you need multiple remit addresses, list them in the onboarding form.

Ive attached our PO template and the vendor onboarding form (please return a signed copy and your W-9). Once we have the W-9 + bank remittance details well kick off vendor activation and issue the first PO.

Next steps: Jordan - send back completed onboarding form + W-9 + bank details. Marissa - flag if we should prioritize Net30 for commercial reasons. Karthik - FYI for Finance review on early-pay options.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-0182
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@valence.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>; Valence AI - AP <ap@valence.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 10:40:23 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: payment cadence & PO routing (Valence AI)
Attachments: valence_w9.pdf, valence_bank_details.pdf

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the checklist. We prefer Net 30 if possible — Valence is running an aggressive ramp with Redwood and Net 30 would help our supply chain commit to delivery dates. We are also open to the early-pay option; our AP team typically accepts 1% for payment within 10 days or 0.5% for payment within 7 days depending on cashflow. Please let us know which, if any, you can accommodate.

Attached is our W-9 and bank remittance PDF. Our invoices will include the PO field, but please confirm the exact formatting so our billing system maps correctly (we include PO on line 1 currently).

Kim / Karthik,

Quick note from the account side: Valence is a high-velocity integration partner for Q2 and their engineers start billable work the week after PO issuance. Net 30 materially helps their delivery schedule. If Finance can support 1%/10 days Id recommend approving for the initial 90-day ramp to remove headwinds on delivery.

I ran a quick back-of-envelope against our take-rate model (link in Drive below) and the unit economics look acceptable for a short pilot. If Finance wants a smaller discount to test, 0.75%/10 days is workable.

Marissa

Kim / Marissa,

After reviewing Valences ramp profile and the AP docs they provided, Finance can provisionally approve an early-pay arrangement for the first 90 days: 0.75% discount if invoices are paid within 10 calendar days. Conditions:

- Valence must complete the attached early-pay enrollment form and return it signed.
- Invoices must contain the Redwood PO number on the first line and be submitted as a single PDF to ap-invoices@redwood.com. Missing or malformed PO fields will push payment to standard cycle.
- We will review utilization at day 60 and may adjust the program (either extend or revert to Net 45).

We will update the vendor record once onboarding docs + W-9 are in the AP portal. Kimberly, please route the completed forms to vendor-ops@redwood.com and cc finance-payments@redwood.com. Marissa, we will enable the early-pay flag for REQ-3342 after the enrollment form is signed.

Thanks,
